task.title: Verify key definition scope for Insert Keyword pop-ups across root map and topics
task.shortdesc: Confirm that keys defined in the root map are in scope for the topic where Insert Keyword is used and that the editor resolves them correctly.

step.cmd: {'step': 'Open the root DITA map that contains the <keydef> entries and confirm each key has a resolvable target (href or keyref chain) and a unique key name.'}
{'step': 'Confirm the topic where Insert Keyword is failing is referenced (directly or indirectly) by the same root map, not opened as a standalone file outside map context.'}
{'step': 'Check whether the topic is included via a submap; if so, verify the submap is referenced from the root map in a way that preserves key scope (no unintended keyspace isolation).'}
{'step': 'If your tool supports key scopes/keyspaces, verify whether the <keydef> is inside a scoped container and move or duplicate it to the correct scope for the target topic.'}
{'step': 'In the editor, refresh/reload the map context (close and reopen the map, then reopen the topic from the map) and retry Insert Keyword to confirm keys are now offered.'}

result.p: Expected result after completing this task.
